## Atlassian Remote MCP Server

The Atlassian MCP server is a cloud-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server from Atlassian that lets AI assistants and agents work with Atlassian Cloud data, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket Cloud, Loom, Goals, Projects, and Assets. Version 2 exposes a small set of primary tools directly, plus `discover` and `executeRead`/`executeWrite`/`executeDestructive` tools that give agents access to the full catalog of product tools on demand. Authentication uses OAuth 2.1 by default, with optional API token support, and all operations respect the user's existing Atlassian permissions. Some Teamwork Graph and search tools are enriched and consume Rovo credits.
